deviations.what: Remote access uses two Cloudflare tunnels (cultureflare's default per-hostname tunnels) and two cloudflared services under the compose 'remote' profile (TUNNEL_TOKEN_UI for ebooks.culture.dev -> http://api:8780, TUNNEL_TOKEN_DEVICE for xteink.culture.dev -> http://api:8781) instead of one tunnel/one cloudflared/one TUNNEL_TOKEN
deviations.reason: cultureflare ensure_tunnel_config replaces a tunnel's whole ingress list (_remote_login/_tunnel.py:68-105), so two hostnames cannot share one tunnel; user chose two tunnels over blocking on a cultureflare change (2026-10-06)

deviations.what: Tabbed screens (Settings and other UiTabListActivity lists): Left/Right switch tabs, Up/Down move between rows on the current tab; replaces upstream's single ring where all four keys step tab-band+rows and tab switching needs a long press (UiTabListActivity.cpp:62-86, MappedInputManager.cpp:154-162). Scope extension of t14 (input), implemented in the fork and reflashed after provisioning
deviations.reason: User expectation stated during X3 hands-on (2026-10-06): 'On settings, I expect left and right to move tabs, and up/down to move down the options on that tab'
